'''Beedo''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] in the employ of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. He was a member of the [[Tetsu Clan]] and a cousin of [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]].

==Biography==
[[File:Beedo_GH.jpg|thumb|180px|left|Beedo]]
Beedo somehow survived the Tetsu Clan purges perpetrated by [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red's]] [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza]] hunters. As a part of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] criminal organization, a "notorious sycophant," he was a loyal&mdash;if terrified&mdash;courtier. Beedo was fearful of Jabba's wrath until [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] killed the Hutt shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Beedo.png|thumb|180px|right|Beedo]]
Beedo was first named in early [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']] spin off materials, including a [[Topps]] trading card set, which refers to him as a relative of Greedo.<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=1983 Topps Star Wars: Return of the Jedi Series 1|cardname=Beedo and a Jawa|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/72969/cid/5256869}}</ref>

In ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]'', the [[Wikipedia:Computer game bot|bot]] of the Rodian character in the [[Wikipedia:Multiplayer game|multiplayer]] mode is named "Beedo." Beedo does not actually appear in the game's storyline.
